facts.fact: 大多数 Academie 学者认为第四年最难，但 Alys 最难的是第三年：魔法突然失控、起伏不定，毁了她那些小心的治疗，实践课与考试成绩都差得危险；第三年暑假她补修 intervention 与 diagnostics
facts.anchor: her magic flared up out of nowhere, rising and falling like a young man’s voice

facts.fact: Alys 在宿舍房间名册上查到 Genevieve Balenne——Lord Baizelat 的侄孙女——随即上到顶层
facts.anchor: found Genevieve Balenne, the grandniece of Lord Baizelat

facts.fact: Theo 冲口问 Alys：Estiene Marcelle 是不是为了阻止 Ysabel 抢在他前面拿到一个 diagnostics 职位而杀了她；Alys 坚决否认 Estiene 杀过人
facts.anchor: killed her to stop her from taking one of the diagnostics jobs ahead of him

facts.fact: Xavi 把笔记交给 Alys，说记不准确；Ysabel 教的技法是调动病人自身魔法，而她本人就是病人：她背痛，让组员拿她练手，好让 Gennie 对 groupwork 更有信心
facts.anchor: She had a sore back and let us have a go at using the technique to heal her

facts.fact: Balenne 说她们是同一届第一年 tutorial group，从此一直一起学习；Alys 笑着掩饰嫉妒
facts.anchor: We were a first-year tutorial group,” said Balenne

facts.fact: 母亲 Jammetta 送给 Alys 一本绿色皮面新日记本，里面已用她工整的字迹写好几项预约：社交宴请与私人治疗师的出诊
facts.anchor: a fresh datebook, bound in handsome green-dyed leather, for the year ahead

facts.fact: Alys 想暑假先休息，并去 Hospital 的 courtyard clinic 值班；母亲反对，说想帮穷人不如办慈善晚宴，还说 There’s only one Alys Tixerrant
facts.anchor: There’s only one Alys Tixerrant.” She stood and kissed Alys’s cheeks

facts.fact: Yvonne 的妹妹是一年级生，把八卦全传给她：一年级有人在与 Konrad Omeyer 交往，妹妹认为多半是为将来攀关系；Yvonne 答应从一年级八卦里替 Konrad 挖不在场证明
facts.anchor: drag any kind of alibi for Konrad out of the first-year gossip mill
